name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow — Plan smarter. Stay organized. Get things done. A lightweight to-do manager built with HTML5, CSS3 and Vanilla JavaScript.

scripts.lint: echo 'No linter configured. Add ESLint for enhanced code quality.' && exit 0
scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const PORT = 8080; http.createServer((req, res) => { let fp = req.url === '/' ? './index.html' : '.' + req.url; const ext = path.extname(fp); const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'application/javascript' }; try { const data = fs.readFileSync(fp); res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': types[ext] || 'text/plain' }); res.end(data); } catch (e) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(PORT, () => console.log('TaskFlow running on http://localhost:' + PORT));"
